class.name: VariableInfo
class.brief_description: Read-only view of one GDScript variable.
class.description: Built by [ReflectionUtils] from a [PropertyInfo] on the declaring script. No setters. [code]static[/code] is not a property name because it is a GDScript keyword; read [member is_static].

members.member: [code]true[/code] when the property usage includes storage or editor.
[code]true[/code] when the variable is a static variable on [member gdscript].
The script that declares the variable.
The [enum Variant.Type] from the property. [code]0[/code] is untyped.
The property class name when [member type] is [Object].
